title: Form builder of {name}
intro: Edit the form as a draft, see the real form, then publish it as a new version. Requests already made keep their version.
open: Edit the form in the form builder
noFields: This form has no extra questions; requesters fill in the items or services only
noCurrent: This type has no form yet. Create a draft and add questions.
startTitle: Edit the form as a new version
startIntro: The draft starts from the form in use. Requesters keep using that form until the draft is published.
unsaved: There are changes not saved yet. Save the draft before you leave this page.
problemsTitle: The draft could not be saved. Fix these, then save again.
noFieldsDraft: This draft has no questions yet. Add a question to start.
noRulesDraft: This draft has no attachment rules. Add a rule when some requests must attach files.
serviceEndDateKept: Lines must carry the day the service ends when {condition} (kept from the version in use; change it with a JSON import)
stepsKept: This form is filled in {count} steps (kept from the version in use; change them with a JSON import)
changesIntro: The draft as last saved, against version {version} in use
changesIntroFirst: This type has no form in use; this draft will be the first version
noChange: This draft is the same as the version in use; there is nothing to publish yet
changesTitle: What changes from the version in use
saveFirst: Save the draft before you publish. The changes and checks above are those of the draft as last saved.
published: Form version {version} published. New requests use this form from now on.
confirmText: New requests use this version at once. Requests already made keep their own version. A published version cannot be undone; to change it again, create the next draft.
confirmAuditor: This draft changes the attachment rules: the AUDITOR is told the moment it is published.
confirmAuditorNone: This draft does not change the attachment rules. When they change, the AUDITOR is told at once.
lintTitle: Cannot be published: other rules read these questions. Bring the question back or change the rules that read it first.
lint: Question {field} is read by {by}, so it cannot be removed or change its type

errors.NO_CHANGE: This draft is the same as the version in use. Change and save the draft before you publish.
errors.NOT_DRAFT: This draft was published or changed already. Reload this page to see the latest version.

allRowsHint: The question shows, or the rule applies, when every row holds

rowErrors.FIELD: Choose the question or value of the request to compare
rowErrors.VALUE: Enter the value to compare with
rowErrors.MONEY: Enter an amount in baht with at most 2 decimals, e.g. 100000.00

keptCondition: This condition uses either-or or groups inside groups, which this page cannot edit row by row. It is kept as it is, or replace it with new conditions.
keptRequirement: What this rule asks for uses either-or or questions to fill in, which this page cannot edit. It is kept as it is, or replace it with a new list of files.
replaceRequirement: Replace with a new list of files
dialogNotSaved: Changes made here go into the draft on the page, and are saved when you press Save draft

fieldDialog.description: A question requesters see on the request form. Write it in both Thai and English.
fieldDialog.fix: This question cannot be used yet. Fix the inputs marked below.
fieldDialog.idHint: An English letter first, then letters, digits or _, e.g. siteContact
fieldDialog.optionsHint: The option code is kept in the request; the Thai and English text is what requesters see
fieldDialog.visibilityHint: A hidden question is neither checked nor saved in the request
fieldDialog.alwaysShown: No condition: this question always shows
fieldDialog.add: Add the question to the draft
fieldDialog.apply: Apply the changes to this question

fieldErrors.ID_FORMAT: The id starts with an English letter, then letters, digits or _, at most 64 characters
fieldErrors.ID_TAKEN: Another question of the form has this id. Use another one.
fieldErrors.LABEL_REQUIRED: Enter the question in both Thai and English
fieldErrors.HELP_BOTH: Enter the hint in both languages, or leave both empty
fieldErrors.OPTIONS_REQUIRED: A choice question needs at least 1 option
fieldErrors.OPTION_VALUE: Enter the code of every option
fieldErrors.OPTION_DUPLICATE: Two options have the same code. Use different codes.
fieldErrors.OPTION_LABEL_BOTH: Enter the option text in both languages, or leave both empty

ruleDialog.description: When a request meets the condition, the requester must attach the files the rule asks for before sending it
ruleDialog.fix: This rule cannot be used yet. Fix the inputs marked below.
ruleDialog.always: No condition: this rule applies to every request of this type
ruleDialog.allFilesHint: Every file listed must be attached
ruleDialog.add: Add the rule to the draft
ruleDialog.apply: Apply the changes to this rule

ruleErrors.ID_FORMAT: The rule id has no spaces and at most 64 characters
ruleErrors.ID_TAKEN: Another rule of the form has this id. Use another one.
ruleErrors.MIN: Enter the number of files as a whole number from 1
ruleErrors.EMPTY: Add at least 1 kind of file to attach

preview.title: Form preview
preview.intro: The real form as drafted on this page. Answer the questions or enter an amount to see the questions conditions show and the files to attach. Nothing is saved.
preview.amountHint: The preview uses this amount as both the total with VAT and the amount before VAT
preview.noFields: No questions yet; requesters fill in the items or services only
preview.hidden: {count, plural, one {# question is} other {# questions are}} hidden and show when the answers meet their condition
preview.rulesTitle: Files to attach for the answers now
preview.noRules: The answers now need no files under the rules
